title: Chat parser, name normalization and ledger calculations verified in CI
claim: Story S4.2 and the domain part of S4.3, S7.1 and S12.2 are implemented and verified in CI on main: the chat fast-entry parser in Uzbek and Russian, display-name normalization across Latin and Cyrillic, and pure ledger calculations (balance, oldest-first allocation, overdue status, payment history indicator, promise dates). Both were written by helper agents and reviewed by the orchestrator, who re-ran the tests before merging
